package answer

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// SubmitTaskAnswerInput holds submission data.
type SubmitTaskAnswerInput struct {
	StudentID           string
	TaskID              string
	StudentTaskAnswerID string
	FilestorageID       string
}

// SubmitTaskAnswer submits attempt for review.
type SubmitTaskAnswer struct {
	Answers      repository.StudentTaskAnswerRepository
	TaskProvider TaskProvider
	Progression  *ProgressionService
}

// Handle moves answer to review and publishes event.
func (uc SubmitTaskAnswer) Handle(ctx context.Context, in SubmitTaskAnswerInput) (*domain.StudentTaskAnswer, error) {
	answer, err := uc.Answers.GetByID(ctx, in.StudentTaskAnswerID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if answer.StudentID != in.StudentID || answer.TaskID != in.TaskID {
		return nil, domain.ErrForbidden
	}
	if answer.Status != domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusInProgress {
		return nil, domain.ErrAnswerNotInProgress
	}
	task, err := taskForAnswer(ctx, uc.TaskProvider, answer)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	now := time.Now().UTC()
	if task.Status != domain.TaskStatusActive {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if task.DeadlineAt != nil && now.After(task.DeadlineAt.UTC()) {
		return nil, domain.ErrInvalidStatus
	}
	if err := requireAnswerTaskUnlocked(ctx, uc.Progression, answer); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	answer.FilestorageID = &in.FilestorageID
	answer.EndedAt = &now
	answer.Status = domain.StudentTaskAnswerStatusUnderReview
	answer.UpdatedAt = now

	if err := uc.Answers.Update(ctx, *answer); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}

	return answer, nil
}
